slides.texte_overlay:
Things a man should never
apologise for
Going to bed early. Leaving the party at eleven because you have plans in the morning isn't boring. It's choosing your goals over other people's habits.
Not drinking. Whether it's one night or forever, "No thanks, I'm good" is a full answer. You never owe anyone an explanation for what you drink.
Being ambitious. Wanting more from your career, your body or your life isn't arrogance. Quietly working toward big goals is nothing to hide.
Changing your mind. New information, new opinion. Updating your views when you learn something is a strength, not a weakness or a betrayal of who you were.
Loving to learn. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and I've stopped hiding that I really enjoy knowing how the world works.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. I've stopped hiding how much I genuinely enjoy learning.

slides.texte_overlay: Ending a relationship that isn't right. Staying out of guilt hurts both people. Leaving with honesty and respect is the kind and right thing to do.
Taking care of your mental health. Therapy, rest days, quiet time. Looking after your mind is as normal and as necessary as going to the gym, and nobody should feel ashamed of it.
